title: Ford stock jumped as much as 25% in two days after the launch of Ford Energy, a new subsidiary providing battery storage capacity to AI data centers (Christian Davies/Financial Times)
summary: Christian Davies / Financial Times: Ford stock jumped as much as 25% in two days after the launch of Ford Energy, a new subsidiary providing battery storage capacity to AI data centers — New subsidiary pivots to energy storage batteries for AI after disastrous electric vehicle writedown — Shares in Detroit auto giant Ford surged …
contentText:
